text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the station kiosk, 'UMASK'. The 
headlines on the sports newspapers lined 
up there caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look at this!! Th-th-this right 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen fan vote! I'm in the 
top 3 in the midterm results!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just one spot behind McQueen. On top of 
that, finishing top three...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This has to be some kind of mistake... It 
is a mistake, right?
choice_data_list:
Congratulations! You've become quite the 
celebrity, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Popular? Me? But... I don't really feel 
that way...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Mejiro Ryan over there?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, Ryan doesn't really ride trains, 
does she? Though come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scrambled onto the train. Everything 
around me was gradually beginning to 
change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I only got to run in last year's 
Arima Kinen because McQueen pulled in all 
the votes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Making the top three, however...
choice_data_list:
It's because you worked so hard at the 
"Tenno Sho."

Isn't it because you worked so hard at the 
"Tenno Sho"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho... Then does that mean 
working hard resulted in gaining 
popularity?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just ran with all my might, and that 
made me popular...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Somehow... Somehow, I'm just so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that someone was properly watching 
what I've done makes me feel so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Effort leads to ability, and ability leads 
to popularity...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The clouds part, and light shines through. 
What Mejiro Ryan desires—she just might be 
able to attain it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm calling it quits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pretending I've given up, lying to myself. 
And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes embarrassed by her childish, 
starry-eyed dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I want to become a star Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who can truly take 
in everyone's support and respond to it 
with confidence."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why, in races chosen by fan voting, 
I want to win no matter what, absolutely 
win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This year's Takarazuka Kinen and Arima 
Kinen... I'm definitely winning both!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the two major Grand Prix in the 
same year. Achieve that, and you are 
undisputedly a superstar Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's a high hurdle to clear. 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
May I take on the challenge? No, not just 
a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to achieve it together with you, 
Trainer! This 100% earnest dream of mine!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I finally found it...! My treasure!! A 
dream of mine that won't lose to 
McQueen's!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This dream, together with Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you see this news?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This year's Takarazuka Kinen is being held 
at Kyoto Racecourse, isn't it? Just like 
the Spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a look at it, it was indeed written 
just like that. Apparently, it was due to 
renovations at Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "On that stage, once more with McQueen..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see, McQueen did say that. 'Next, we 
settle this at medium distance.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen already knew. She knew I'd be 
chosen for the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which means Mejiro McQueen should be 
entering the Takarazuka Kinen as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage for the next showdown is set. 
This time, I'll take on my rival at my 
specialty—middle distance.
